tickets.title: US005: Auto-Pause Orders During Offline Mode
tickets.description:
As an IT Administrator, I want the system to automatically pause incoming mobile orders if the Kitchen Display System loses Wi-Fi connection, so that students do not place orders that the kitchen cannot currently receive.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: If the server detects the KDS is offline for more than 60 seconds, the mobile app displays a "Live ordering temporarily paused" banner.
2. Pass/Fail: The KDS continues to display already-received orders without crashing.
